source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 1994 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 1994 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. County cells and statewide totals transcribed from page 1 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State; every candidate's 15 county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL. Cells were read from the printed page images. Named write-ins are included. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer from the Secretary of State and is retained under data/raw/us-senate/pdfs with its SHA-256 recorded in the snapshots. Event turnout is shared with the Governor and Attorney General contests of the same election.
